entities.name: Sandsteppe
entities.description: Central territory of the nomadic Mardu Horde, formerly of the Kolaghan brood, on Tarkir.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: Nomadic clan living on the Sandsteppe.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: Dragon who died smashed against a cliffside at the Wingthrone; Screamreach was his favored domain.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: Clan whose city Sandsteppe Gate was captured by the Mardu.

entities.name: Sandsteppe Gate
entities.description: Former Abzan city captured by the Mardu.

entities.name: Wingthrone
entities.description: Mardu fortress where Kolaghan died in ancient times.

entities.name: Screamreach
entities.description: Bog system near Abzan, Mardu and Sultai territory, Kolaghan's favored domain.

entities.name: The Scour
entities.description: Deep chasm into the Qal Sisma mountains and a frequent point of conflict.

entities.name: Dragonsong Rock
entities.description: Rock formation regarded as a peaceful meeting point for diplomacy.

events.summary: The Mardu capture the Abzan city of Sandsteppe Gate.
events.quote: A former Abzan city that has since been captured by the Mardu.

events.summary: In ancient times Kolaghan dies at the Wingthrone, smashed against a cliffside.
events.quote: the Mardu fortress where Kolaghan died in ancient times, smashed against a cliffside

relations.quote: is the territory of the nomadic Mardu Horde
